Sena / Our story

About Sena

A simpler way.
A warmer welcome.

Sena started with a simple question: why does running a hospitality business still require so many different tools?

The story behind Sena ↓

01 / The beginning

Less juggling.
More hospitality.

Reservations live in one place, payments in another, the website somewhere else, while front-desk teams are still juggling calls, messages and spreadsheets just to keep everything moving.

We thought there should be a simpler way.

Sena brings the everyday tools hospitality businesses need into one place. Reservations, rooms, guests, payments, websites, direct bookings, housekeeping and day-to-day operations, all designed to work together.

A little more room for hospitality.

02 / Built from experience

Built with people.
For people.

Winner OyebanjoFounder, Sena & Nile Africa Technologies

Sena was founded by Winner Oyebanjo, founder of Nile Africa Technologies, after years of building software for African businesses and working closely with the people who use it every day.

That experience shaped a simple belief behind Sena: good business software shouldn't make running a business feel more complicated. It should quietly take complexity away.

We're starting with hotels and serviced properties, building alongside real hospitality operators and solving the problems they actually encounter, one by one.

And we're only getting started.

Our belief, in a few words.

sena.
hospitality, simplified.
